name: Exchange8
tagline: Capital markets on Sentin8 - a deterministic matching engine with FIX/OUCH access, peg and algorithmic order supervision, smart order routing, clearing, margin, and multi-jurisdiction regulation.
pillarsLead: Exchange8 inherits the Sentin8 security model and adds market guarantees - deterministic matching, reproducible event sourcing, and synchronous pre-trade authorization on every order.

pillars.title: Deterministic matching
pillars.summary: The central-limit-order-book core is a pure function over order events - the same input stream always produces the same fills, run to run.

pillars.title: Synchronous pre-trade gates
pillars.summary: Every order passes Exchange8:Risk authorization before the matching engine sees it - buying power, limits, and restrictions checked on the submission path.

pillars.title: Event-sourced ledger
pillars.summary: Clearing consumes order/trade lifecycle events and projects them into a deterministic SQL ledger - the books are rebuildable from replay.

pillars.title: Reproducible derivatives risk
pillars.summary: Margin revalues positions per (env, account, contract) from the reference-data curves and mark events - an asynchronous, stateful engine, auditable end to end.

pillars.title: Surveillance as a first-class tier
pillars.summary: The eight regulatory detection families run on the live trade/order stream and turn detections into reviewable cases - compliance is not an afterthought.

units.name: Exchange8:Gateway
units.summary: The market-access front end: FIX 4.2 client sessions (with an OUCH binary-codec subset and BFF-proxied REST/WebSocket shapes), session protocol, sequence integrity, resends, heartbeats, order states above the fill.

units.name: Exchange8:ME
units.summary: The deterministic central-limit-order-book matching core: price-time priority, self-trade prevention, and the fill events every downstream tier consumes.

units.name: Exchange8:OMS
units.summary: Peg/iceberg supervision and conditional-order triggers: pegged orders (primary/market/midpoint, dark variant), iceberg slice plans, stop/OCO/bracket triggers - released to ME only when they fire.

units.name: Exchange8:Risk
units.summary: The synchronous pre-trade authorization service: every submitted order is checked (buying power, limits, restricted securities) before the matching engine sees it.

units.name: Exchange8:MD
units.summary: The consolidated market-data publisher: consumes matching-engine order/trade/status events and publishes the public market-data tiers (BBO, trades, depth).

units.name: Exchange8:SOR
units.summary: The smart order router: routes orders to external venues and home again - routing requests, venue state, fill consolidation, and re-posts to ME.

units.name: Exchange8:Clearing
units.summary: The event-sourced order/trade ledger: consumes lifecycle events from the venue flow and projects them into a deterministic SQL ledger of positions and trades.

units.name: Exchange8:Settlement
units.summary: External settlement integrations: novation (CCP substitution), custody and collateral for crypto and fiat rails, give-up/give-in flows.

units.name: Exchange8:Margin
units.summary: The asynchronous derivatives-risk engine: net-position ledger per (env, account, contract) for futures, perpetuals, and options; revalues and issues margin calls.

units.name: Exchange8:RFQ
units.summary: The quote-driven trading engine for FX: clients broadcast RFQs (pair, side, qty, tenor), entitled liquidity providers respond with two-way prices inside a bounded window.

units.name: Exchange8:RefData
units.summary: The reference-data authority: security master, markets, MIC venues, currencies, order books, tick rules, market calendars, customer/firm registration.

units.name: Exchange8:Regulatory
units.summary: Multi-jurisdiction regulatory reporting: reportable order/trade/quote activity normalized into one event shape and fanned out to every configured jurisdiction.

units.name: Exchange8:Surveillance
units.summary: Market surveillance: the eight regulatory detection families (spoofing, layering, wash trades, and more) run on the live stream and turn detections into reviewable cases.

units.name: Exchange8:VFeeds
units.summary: External venue feeds: consolidates BBO from outside venues, maintains the index quotes the peg and SOR tiers consume.

apps.name: eExchange
apps.summary: The exchange trading app: order entry, market data, account positions - for members and desk operators.

sdks.name: exchange8 Rust SDK
sdks.summary: The shared vertical plane: FIX/OUCH/ITCH codecs, fixed/Price-Qty math, event contracts, and the typed clients every exchange8 service and integrator consumes.

showcaseLead: Exchange8 contains no platform infrastructure of its own - identity, events, storage, scheduling, and supervision are consumed from the platform.

showcase.name: Sentin8 - the platform
showcase.summary: 17 services: identity, events, storage, workflows, scheduling - everything exchange8 doesn't rebuild.

showcase.name: Trade8
showcase.summary: The broker-side trading vertical - desk, router, and feeds against any market.
